verdict: Figma grew revenue 48% to $370M — a third straight quarter of faster growth, in its first full quarter of AI credit sales — but post-IPO stock pay kept GAAP results at a $112M loss; excluding stock pay, operations earned $36M.

segments.name: Subscriptions & AI credits
segments.note: Design-tool subscriptions (per-seat plans for Figma, Dev Mode, Make and Sites) plus usage credits for AI features. Figma reports one revenue stream. Q2 was the first full quarter of AI credit monetization.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Building the design platform and its AI features — heavy with stock pay.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: Selling seats to design and product teams — this quarter also carried the cost of Config, Figma's annual user conference.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Running the company day to day — also heavy with post-IPO stock pay.

follow100Note: Rows add up with a small rounding difference. Costs ran to $130.31 per $100 of revenue — the extra is the loss, covered by cash the company already had.

takeaways.title: Growth accelerated again
takeaways.text: Revenue growth quickened for the third straight quarter, and Figma raised its full-year revenue outlook to $1.463–1.467B.

takeaways.title: Customers keep expanding
takeaways.text: Net dollar retention was 136% — existing customers spent 36% more than a year ago — as teams bought more seats and, in the first full quarter of AI credits, more AI usage: over 80% of larger paid customers used AI credits weekly.

takeaways.title: Stock pay is the loss
takeaways.text: Stock-based compensation was $148M in the quarter. Without it and related items, Figma earned $36M of operating income and $43M of net income (non-GAAP) instead of the GAAP loss.

oneTimers: Figma listed on the NYSE in July 2025. Newly public companies often show large GAAP losses as employee stock awards vest: stock-based compensation was $148M this quarter, versus just $7M in Q2 2025 before the IPO.
otherDetail: Other income of $7.6M, net — interest earned on Figma's cash and investments, partly offset by a $4.4M loss on equity investments and a $1.7M writedown of digital assets.
footerNote: GAAP figures include $148M of stock-based compensation.
